description: CaNaAsO₄ is Spinel-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.53 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-69°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.46 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-59°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.74 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one As atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one As atom.
